root: ^Gah!! What is that?? More flushing trash!!
^Hey! I’m not trash! I’m a cat!
^I’ve never heard of...what did you say, a cat? You look flushing weird.
^I guess it makes sense that you’ve never seen a cat.
^We famously hate water. This is kinda a big deal for me.
^I’m not in a good mood right now.
^The gods above keep throwing dangerous, indestructible things down here!
^And someone’s just thrown the biggest flushing thing that I’ve ever seen!
^Yeah, people up there don’t care as long as they can’t see it anymore, kinda like how they all ignore me…
^Wait, a really big piece of trash?
^Really flushing weird shape too. And a horrible colour, I thought it was a giant stink rock at first.
^And where might this stink rock be?
^I don’t care about that right now! I can’t focus with all this trash everywhere!
